name: OPC Dev
postCreateCommand: bash -lc 'command -v python3 >/dev/null || (apt-get update && apt-get install -y python3 python3-pip); python3 -m pip show ipykernel >/dev/null 2>&1 || python3 -m pip install --no-cache-dir ipykernel jupyter numpy pandas matplotlib laspy plyfile; jupyter kernelspec list | grep -q "opc-py" || python3 -m ipykernel install --name opc-py --display-name "Python (OPC container)"'
